types.name: AccessPermission
docs: Compliance status for a (user, role) assignment, set by an admin after
off-chain KYC/AML. Only the marketplace's investor-fund calls (listing,
buying, offers, share transfers, lawyer case work) require this flag on
top of the role; every other instruction checks role possession alone.
Later it'll be driven by a SAS attestation instead of a manual toggle.
Do not reorder the variants: the serialized `RoleAccount.permission`
stores the variant index, so a reorder flips every stored status.

types.name: CollectedPerMint
docs: One payment mint's totals across the primary sale, in that mint's units.

types.name: Config
docs: Singleton config holding protocol parameters and the authority.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority allowed to update parameters.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Proposed replacement authority; takes over via `accept_authority`.
Two-step so a typo'd address can't brick parameter management.

fields.name: xcav_mint
docs: The XCAV mint listing and lawyer deposits are paid in.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Owner of the shared protocol treasury (a multisig on mainnet). Fees are
paid to this key's token accounts; the program never holds them.

fields.name: rent_collector
docs: The sponsor wallet that fronts account rent for investors. Every
position close sends its lamports here, not to the investor.

fields.name: accepted_payment_mints
docs: Mints a property can be priced and paid in. Every entry must be a
same-value GBP stablecoin: prices convert between them by decimal
count alone, so adding a mint of different value would misprice every
open listing.

fields.name: listing_deposit
docs: XCAV a developer locks to list a property.

fields.name: lawyer_deposit
docs: XCAV a lawyer locks to join the registry.

fields.name: min_property_shares
docs: Fewest shares a property may be split into.

fields.name: max_property_shares
docs: Most shares a property may be split into.

fields.name: marketplace_fee_bps
docs: Protocol fee taken from the developer's proceeds, in basis points.

fields.name: investor_fee_bps
docs: Fee an investor pays on top of the share price, in basis points.

fields.name: max_ownership_bps
docs: Largest slice of a property one investor may hold, in basis points.

fields.name: claiming_time
docs: Seconds the claim window stays open once the SPV exists.

fields.name: legal_process_time
docs: Seconds the legal process may run before it expires.

fields.name: lawyer_voting_time
docs: Seconds the SPV lawyer election stays open once the first lawyer claims.

fields.name: min_voting_quorum_bps
docs: Share of a property's supply that must vote for the SPV lawyer election
to be valid, in basis points.

fields.name: next_listing_id
docs: Monotonic id for the next listing.

types.name: ConfigParams
docs: Protocol parameters for the marketplace program.

types.name: DocumentStatus
docs: Where a lawyer's document review stands.

fields.name: documents_hash
docs: The document set the verdict rules on.

fields.name: status
docs: Where the verdict left the sale.

types.name: InvestorPosition
docs: One investor's stake in a primary listing: what they paid, per component,
so refunds and settlement can be exact. The shares themselves are already
delivered; this is the accounting.

fields.name: payment_mint
docs: The mint the investor paid in. One mint per position: later buys must
use the same one, so every refund is a single transfer.

fields.name: payment_account
docs: The investor's token account the reservation is recorded against and
the claim later pays from.

fields.name: share_amount
docs: Shares paid for and delivered.

fields.name: reserved_share_amount
docs: Shares reserved and not yet claimed; a claim converts all of them at
once, so a position is only ever reserved or paid, not both.

fields.name: paid_funds
docs: Paid toward the property price, in payment-mint base units.

fields.name: paid_tax
docs: Paid as sale tax on top, in payment-mint base units.

fields.name: paid_fee
docs: Paid as the investor fee on top, in payment-mint base units.

fields.name: reserved_funds
docs: Reserved toward the property price, still in the investor's wallet.

fields.name: reserved_tax
docs: Reserved for the sale tax, still in the investor's wallet.

fields.name: reserved_fee
docs: Reserved for the investor fee, still in the investor's wallet.

fields.name: cancelled
docs: Set when the investor unreserved. The position stays open as the
one-way re-buy bar: `buy` rejects a cancelled position forever.

types.name: Lawyer
docs: A lawyer registered to take cases in a region. One registration per wallet;
only registered lawyers can be assigned to a sale.

fields.name: region_id
docs: The region the lawyer serves; cases must match it.

fields.name: deposit
docs: The XCAV locked at registration, held in the vault. Returned on
unregister, even if the configured deposit has changed since.

fields.name: active_cases
docs: Cases currently assigned; must be zero to unregister.

types.name: LawyerAssignment
docs: One side's engaged lawyer on a sold-out sale.

fields.name: lawyer
docs: The lawyer on this side; default until one is engaged.

fields.name: costs
docs: What they charge, quoted at `PRICE_DECIMALS`. Only the SPV side is
paid from the collected fees; the developer's lawyer is a private
arrangement, so their side stays zero.

fields.name: documents_hash
docs: Hash of the document set the verdict was passed on; zero while
pending. Both sides must rule on the same hash.

types.name: LawyerCandidacy
docs: One lawyer standing in one SPV election round; carries their own tally.
Whoever fronts the rent (the sponsor by default) takes it back with
`close_candidacy` once the round is over.

fields.name: round
docs: The election round the candidacy belongs to.

fields.name: costs
docs: What the candidate would charge, quoted at `PRICE_DECIMALS`.

fields.name: vote_power
docs: Share-weighted votes cast for this candidate.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the account's rent; refunded at close.

types.name: LawyerVote
docs: One investor's vote in one SPV lawyer election round. Locks the voting
shares until the record is closed again by `unlock_voting_shares`.

fields.name: round
docs: The election round the vote belongs to.

fields.name: choice
docs: The candidate voted for.

fields.name: power
docs: The shares this vote locked and counts for.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the record's rent; refunded at close.

types.name: Listing
docs: A primary property listing. Prices and windows are snapshotted here at
listing time, so config or region changes never reprice a sale underway.

fields.name: share_price
docs: Price per share, in payment-mint base units.

fields.name: listed_share_amount
docs: Shares put up for sale.

fields.name: sold_share_amount
docs: Shares sold (paid for) so far.

fields.name: reserved_share_amount
docs: Shares reserved but not yet claimed. Reserved money stays in the
investors' own wallets until the claim pays for them.

fields.name: tax_paid_by_developer
docs: Whether the developer covers the region's sale tax themselves.

fields.name: tax_bps
docs: The region's sale tax at listing time, in basis points.

fields.name: marketplace_fee_bps
docs: Protocol fee at listing time, in basis points.

fields.name: investor_fee_bps
docs: Investor fee at listing time, in basis points.

fields.name: max_ownership_bps
docs: Ownership cap at listing time, in basis points. Holdings must stay
strictly below it, so even 10_000 requires at least two holders.

fields.name: claiming_time
docs: Seconds the claim window runs once the SPV exists, taken from config
at listing time.

fields.name: claim_deadline
docs: When the claim window closes and direct purchases open. Zero until
the SPV attestation stamps it.

fields.name: legal_process_time
docs: Seconds the legal process may run once the listing sells out, taken
from config at listing time.

fields.name: lawyer_voting_time
docs: Seconds the SPV-lawyer election stays open, taken from config at
listing time.

fields.name: min_voting_quorum_bps
docs: Quorum for the SPV-lawyer election, taken from config at listing time.

fields.name: position_count
docs: Open `InvestorPosition` accounts, cancelled ones included. Teardown
waits for zero, so a position can never outlive the listing it needs
to close against.

fields.name: legal_deadline
docs: Set when the last share sells: the moment the legal process runs out
and the timeout exit opens. Zero until then.

fields.name: deposit
docs: The XCAV locked by the developer at listing, held in the vault. Zero
doubles as "already withdrawn", which is unambiguous because config
validation never accepts a zero deposit.

fields.name: developer_lawyer
docs: The developer's lawyer on the sale, allocated by the developer.

fields.name: spv_lawyer
docs: The SPV's lawyer on the sale, chosen by investor vote.

fields.name: second_attempt
docs: Set when a split document verdict sends the papers back for revision.
The revised set is the last chance: a second split cancels the sale.

fields.name: developer_engaged
docs: Whether the developer ever appointed their lawyer. Sticky: a sale that
times out without this costs the developer 1% of the bond, but a
lawyer resigning later doesn't.

fields.name: spv_costs_due
docs: Stamped at cancellation: what the SPV lawyer is still owed from the
retained fees, and who collects it. Kept on the listing because
`close_case` clears the assignment before the fees settle.

fields.name: collected
docs: What each payment mint collected across the sale, split the way
settlement pays it out. Written by every claim and direct buy.

fields.name: slashed
docs: The abandonment slash the treasury kept, if one applied.

types.name: ListingStatus
docs: Where a primary listing is in its lifecycle.

types.name: Location
docs: A registered postcode within a region. Existence is the point: the
marketplace requires a listing's location PDA to exist for its region.

fields.name: postcode
docs: The postcode, as seeded (uppercase ASCII, no spaces).

fields.name: deposit
docs: The XCAV locked when the location was registered. Released on removal,
even if the configured deposit has changed since.

types.name: PropertyAsset
docs: A fractionalized property. Created when it is listed and kept for the
asset's whole life; the Core asset and share mint are attached by
`init_property_assets`.

fields.name: core_asset
docs: The Metaplex Core asset held in the property vault. Default until the
assets are initialized.

fields.name: share_mint
docs: The Token-2022 share mint. Default until the assets are initialized.

fields.name: location
docs: The registered location (postcode) the property sits in.

fields.name: holder_count
docs: Wallets currently holding shares; teardown completes when it reaches
zero again.

types.name: Region
docs: A created region and its operator.

fields.name: collateral
docs: The operator's bonded XCAV plus the location deposits, held in the
vault. Returned when the seat changes hands.

fields.name: location_collateral
docs: The part of `collateral` backing the registered locations: the sum of
every `Location.deposit`. Takeovers and removals move these recorded
amounts, so the seat's bond stays exactly what was locked no matter
how the configured deposit changes in between.

fields.name: listing_duration
docs: Seconds a property listing in this region stays active.

fields.name: tax_bps
docs: Property sale tax for this region, in basis points.

fields.name: location_count
docs: Number of registered locations (each backed by a location deposit).

types.name: Reservation
docs: Payment money promised to unclaimed reservations, one record per token
account, summed across every listing the owner reserved into. Reserving
checks the balance covers it; only the claim actually collects.

types.name: Role
docs: All roles recognised across the realXmarket protocol.
A role is app-level authorization, separate from KYC/compliance. Compliance
lives in [`AccessPermission`], and will eventually be driven by SAS
attestations rather than a manually set flag.
Do not reorder the variants: the serialized `RoleAccount.role` stores the
variant index, so a reorder reinterprets every existing assignment.

types.name: RoleAccount
docs: One (user, role) assignment together with its compliance status.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who paid the account's rent (the assigning admin); every teardown
refunds them, whoever triggers it.

types.name: ShareHolding
docs: The canonical share ledger for one holder of one property. The Token-2022
accounts mirror this; they never lead it.

fields.name: locked_amount
docs: Shares locked by votes; blocked from transfer until unlocked.

fields.name: silent_lawyer
docs: The lawyer who never ruled; default if that side was never engaged.

types.name: SpvElection
docs: The running SPV lawyer election. Any eligible lawyer may stand; the first
candidacy opens the voting window and shareholders vote among the
candidates. A round that elects nobody simply reopens: rounds repeat
until a lawyer is engaged or the legal process expires into its timeout
exit. One round at a time per listing.

fields.name: expiry
docs: When voting closes; zero while no round is running.

fields.name: candidate_count
docs: Candidates standing in the current round.

fields.name: round
docs: Round number, monotonic per listing. Candidacies and vote records are
keyed by it, so nothing stale can count toward a later round.
